parameters.text:
=The current MES (S&P 500 micro) regime is: {{ $('Detect Market Regime').item.json.regime }} (ADX: {{ $('Detect Market Regime').item.json.adx }}). Use this as a directional proxy for equity-index regime context; for MCL (crude micro) and MNQ (Nasdaq micro), assume mixed/unknown regime unless otherwise indicated.

Generate 15 vectorbt-compatible strategies covering Trading Forge's three approved micro-futures contracts: 5 for MES, 5 for MNQ, 5 for MCL.

Each strategy MUST conform to the StrategyDSL schema (src/engine/compiler/strategy_schema.py):
- symbol: EXACT string, one of [MES, MNQ, MCL] (NOT ES, NQ, or CL â€” those are big contracts and out of scope)
- timeframe: one of [1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d]
- direction: long | short | both
- entry_type: one of [breakout, mean_reversion, trend_follow, volatility_expansion, session_pattern, event_driven]
- entry_indicator: a value from kb/indicator-catalog.md (RSI, EMA, SMA, ATR, VWAP, Bollinger, Donchian, Keltner, MACD, etc.)
- entry_params: object, MAX 5 keys, prefer round numbers (RSI 70, not 67.3 â€” tight precision is the overfitting anti-pattern)
- exit_type: one of [fixed_target, trailing_stop, time_exit, indicator_signal, atr_multiple]
- stop_loss_atr_multiple, take_profit_atr_multiple: numbers; SL < TP when both set
- name: snake_case, â‰¤ 100 chars
- description: one sentence, 10-500 chars
- preferred_regime: from kb/regime-taxonomy.md

Distribute across regimes (TRENDING, RANGE_BOUND, VOLATILE, OPENING_RANGE, NEWS_DRIVEN, OVERNIGHT_DRIFT). MES regime above is a directional hint, not a constraint.

Return ONLY a JSON array of 15 StrategyDSL objects. No markdown fences, no prose outside the JSON.

Output JSON-only, no markdown fences, no prose.
